movie.title: Murder at the Embassy
movie.overview: 1934. Private detective Miranda Green investigates a murder perpetrated in the British Embassy in Cairo, where a top secret document was stolen, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world. All those present in this closed place are suspected: the American photographer, the English student, the American actress, the Egyptian security guard, the ambassador interpreter, the Egyptian gardener and - why not? — the Ambassador himself. But who would have expected that a small group of Nazis would be behind a plot, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world?

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In 1934 Cairo, private detective Miranda Green must solve a high-stakes murder at the British Embassy before stolen secret documents drag world powers into war.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Set in 1934, private detective Miranda Green is called to the British Embassy in Cairo following a shocking murder and the theft of a top-secret document. With world peace and the reputation of Buckingham Palace on the line, everyone inside the locked-down embassy becomes a suspect. As Miranda interrogates a diverse group of guests and staff, she unravels a web of deception that stretches far beyond a simple crime. Ultimately, her investigation uncovers a dangerous Nazi conspiracy aiming to ignite a global conflict.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The year is 1934, and the tension inside the British Embassy in Cairo reaches a boiling point when a violent murder coincides with the theft of sensitive state documents. Private investigator Miranda Green takes charge of the locked-down embassy to find the killer and recover the missing intelligence before news leaks to the public. The suspect pool includes a varied assembly of individuals, ranging from an American photographer and a glamorous actress to an English student, an Egyptian security guard, an interpreter, a gardener, and the British Ambassador himself. Each suspect harbors personal secrets, creating a maze of red herrings that complicates Miranda's investigation. As she piecemeal reconstructs the sequence of events leading up to the crime, Miranda discovers that the theft was not motivated by mere blackmail or personal greed. Instead, a clandestine cell of Nazi operatives has infiltrated the diplomatic grounds, engineering the murder as part of a grander political conspiracy. With the stability of Buckingham Palace and international peace hanging in the balance, Miranda must outwit the conspirators before they escape Cairo with the stolen files. Her razor-sharp deduction skills ultimately expose the hidden ringleader and neutralize the threat just in time.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of 1934 Cairo, this atmospheric mystery follows sharp-witted private detective Miranda Green as she investigates a murder inside the secure confines of the British Embassy. The crime coincides with the disappearance of a top-secret document capable of endangering Buckingham Palace and plunging nations into war. Trapped inside with a eccentric array of suspects—including foreign visitors, embassy staff, and high-ranking diplomats—Miranda must untangle a web of secrets and political intrigue to unmask the killer and expose a far-reaching international plot before time runs out.

story_structure.climax: The detective uncovers the true perpetrators behind the theft and plot, bringing the high-stakes confrontation to a head before the stolen secrets can be used.
story_structure.conflict: Miranda must navigate a tight circle of distinct suspects—from embassy staff to visiting foreign nationals—where everyone holds secrets and a motive to conceal the truth.
story_structure.resolution: With the conspirators exposed and the document secured, order is restored to the embassy, neutralizing the immediate threat to international peace.
story_structure.introduction: In 1934 Cairo, private detective Miranda Green is called to the isolated British Embassy after a high-profile murder and the theft of a sensitive document threatening world peace.
story_structure.risingAction: As Miranda investigates the closed-door setting, hidden agendas emerge, political tensions escalate, and clues point toward a broader international conspiracy far exceeding a routine murder.
